# Introduction

This document includes the differential gene expression analysis (DEA) for the gene, transcript and exon expression of the postmortem human brain (dorsolateral prefrontal cortex - Brodmann area 9) samples coming from patients with schizophrenia (SCZ), bipolar disorder (BPD) and major depression disorder (MDD) as well as healthy controls (CTL). We decided to combine all diagnosis (SCZ, BPD and MDD) to one case for power reasons. We did not find any differetnially expressed genes, transcripts or exons using the diagnosis as single cases. Following steps are performed for each level (gene, transcript and exon):

1. Load data and remove samples with missing values and complement the phenotype (annotation) data
2. Search for hidden batch effects and remove them (only one surrogate variable on transcript and exon level)
3. DEA for diagnosis correcting for all covariates
4. DEA using the polygenic risk score instead of the diagnosis (also correcting vor covariates)
5. Generate figures

Below you can find the list of packages that are required by the workflow. 

```{r, echo = F}
# General Bioconductor packages
library(biomaRt)

# Data analysis
library(oligo)
library(sva) # for hidden batch correction
library(limma)  # for differential expression

# Formatting packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# Color palettes
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)

# Packages for plotting 
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(corrplot)
library(grid)
library(ggrepel)  # for volcanoplot
```


# Load data and update phenotypes

Now, we will load the normalized and batch corrected microarray data summarized to gene, transcript and exon level. 

```{r, echo = F}
# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on gene level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/6_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_core_summaries_filtered_gene_summaries_annotated_batch_corrected.RData")
dim(geneSummaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on transcript level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/6_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_transcript_summaries_annotated_batch_corrected.RData")
dim(transcriptSummaries)

# Import RMA corrected and annotated Affymetrix microarray data on exon level
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/RData_Files/6_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_exon_summaries_annotated_batch_corrected.RData")
dim(exonSummaries)
```

## Remove samples with missing values

As we have some missing values in the phenotype data, 26 mds (C1-C10) values, we first need to remove them from the microarrays as well as the phenotype dataset.

```{r, echo = F}
# remove all samples with C1 = NA from phenotype data and gene/transcript/exon expression data
index <- which(is.na(pData(geneSummaries)$C1))
geneSummaries <- geneSummaries[, -c(index)]
transcriptSummaries <- transcriptSummaries[, -c(index)]
exonSummaries <- exonSummaries[, -c(index)]

# remove all samples with Type_of_Death = NA from phenotype data and gene expression data
index <- which(is.na(pData(geneSummaries)$Type_of_Death))
geneSummaries <- geneSummaries[, -c(index)]
transcriptSummaries <- transcriptSummaries[, -c(index)]
exonSummaries <- exonSummaries[, -c(index)]

# check dim of geneSummaries (25 rows should be removed)
dim(geneSummaries)
dim(transcriptSummaries)
dim(exonSummaries)
```

Then, we will check if the phenotype data and the microarray data are still in the same sample order.

```{r}
pData <- pData(geneSummaries)

# check if pData and gene/transcript/exonSummaries are identical
identical(as.character(pData$ShortName), colnames(exprs(geneSummaries)))
identical(as.character(pData$ShortName), colnames(exprs(transcriptSummaries)))
identical(as.character(pData$ShortName), colnames(exprs(exonSummaries)))
```

## Complement Phenotype Data

```{r}
# add original Dx as Diagnosis column to pData
pData["Diagnosis"] <- pData$Dx

# change BPD and MDD diagnosis (Dx) to SCZ
pData$Dx <- as.character(pData$Dx) # change factor column to character
pData[pData$Dx == "BPD" | pData$Dx == "MDD", "Dx"] <- "SCZ" # change BPD and MDD to SCZ
pData[, c("Sex", "Dx", "Suicide")] <- lapply(pData[, c("Sex", "Dx", "Suicide")], factor)

# relevel disease (Dx) to control (CTL)
pData$Dx <- factor(pData$Dx, levels = c("CTL", "SCZ"))

# add quadratic RIN 
pData["RIN2"] <- pData$RIN^2

# remove unnecessary data
rm(index)
```


# Remove hidden batch effects

Before, we can start with the differential gene expression analysis, we need to find out if there are still hidden batch effects included in our datasets. Therefore, we use SVA inlcuding all the covariates we decided to use in the evaluation and selection script to find surrogate variables for our data. 

## Gene level 

```{r, echo = F}
# setting up the data for SVA
pheno <- pData
edata <- exprs(geneSummaries)
mod <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1 + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
# estimate the number of latent factors
n.sv <- num.sv(edata, mod, method = "leek")
# Apply the sva function to extimate surrogate variables:
svobj <- sva(edata, mod, mod0, n.sv = n.sv)
```

Here, num.sv estimated only `r n.sv` surrogate variables. 

## Transcript Level 

```{r, echo = F}
# setting up the data for SVA
pheno <- pData
edata <- exprs(exonSummaries)
mod <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1 + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
# estimate the number of latent factors
n.sv <- num.sv(edata, mod, method = "leek")
# Apply the sva function to extimate surrogate variables:
svobj <- sva(edata, mod, mod0, n.sv = n.sv)
pData$SV1_trans <- svobj$sv
```

Here, num.sv estimated only `r n.sv` surrogate variables. 

## Exon Level 

```{r, echo = F}
# setting up the data for SVA
pheno <- pData
edata <- exprs(exonSummaries)
mod <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1 + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
# estimate the number of latent factors
n.sv <- num.sv(edata, mod, method = "leek")
# Apply the sva function to extimate surrogate variables:
svobj <- sva(edata, mod, mod0, n.sv = n.sv)
pData$SV1_ex <- svobj$sv
```

Here, num.sv estimated only `r n.sv` surrogate variables. 


# Differential Gene Expression Analysis (LIMMA) - Diagnosis

Now, we calculate the differentially expressed genes/transcripts/exons using a linear mixed model (limma package) correcting for all the covariates. We will also generate output tables and vulcano plots for all results.

## Gene level

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, pData)

# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(geneSummaries, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ", adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
head(top.hits)
```

Save the resulting table into an output file. 

```{r}
colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Location", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
write.table(top.hits, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/01_differentially_expressed_genes_for_diagnosis.csv", sep = "\t", row.names = F)
```

Generate a volcano plot for the data:

```{r}
# volcano plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/01_volcano_plot_differentially_expressed_genes_for_diagnosis.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
volcanoplot(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ", names = fit2$genes$gene_name, cex = 0.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, las = 1)
lp <- -log10(fit2$p.value[,"DxSCZ"])
ord <- order(lp, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
points(fit2$coef[ord, "DxSCZ"], lp[ord], pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = viridis(1))
x <- fit2$coef[ord,"DxSCZ"]
y <- lp[ord]
text(x, y, fit2$genes$gene_name[ord], cex = 1.2, col = viridis(1))
dev.off()
```

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates (corrected for all the other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
# Get padj values for all different covariates
nc = ncol(design) - 1
limma.res.fc = topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
limma.res.padj = limma.res.fc[, 4:(3 + nc)]
for (i in 1:nc){
    limma.res.padj[, i] = topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, 8]
}
head(limma.res.padj)
colnames(limma.res.padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
limma.res.padj <- limma.res.padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")]
#pheatmap(as.matrix(limma.res.padj), show_rownames = F)
# check, how many padj values are < 0.10
limma.res.padj.0.05 <- apply(limma.res.padj, 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
limma.res.gene <- data.frame(sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T))
# vertical barplot with ggplot2...
pdf("/storage/scratch/users/karolina.worf/MPIP/04.DEX/figures/barplot_significant_DEA_hits_genes.pdf")
ggplot(limma.res.gene, aes(y = limma.res.gene$sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T., x = reorder(row.names(limma.res.gene), sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T.))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.gene$sort.limma.res.padj.0.05..decreasing...T.), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
dev.off()
```

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates (NOT corrected for all the other covariates). 

```{r, echo = F}
covars <- c("Dx", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
limma.res <- data.frame()
for (var in covars) {
  design <- model.matrix(~ var, pData)
  fit <- lmFit(geneSummaries, design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
  if (var != "Type_of_Death") {
    limma.res[, var] <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = colnames(design)[2])[, 8]
  } else {
    tod1 <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = colnames(design)[2])[, 8]
    tod2 <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = colnames(design)[3])[, 8]
    limma.res[, var] <- (tod1 + tod2) / 2
  }
}
```

Generate Heatmap of significant hits

```{r, echo = F}
# 1. Get gene expression for the two genes with FDR < 0.05
# save mapping of probeid to gene symbol
hits <- top.hits[top.hits$adj.P.Val < 0.1, "SYMBOL"]
probeids <- fData(geneSummaries)[fData(geneSummaries)$SYMBOL %in% hits, c("PROBEID", "SYMBOL")]
# 2. Get gene expression adjusted for all covariates (except Diagnosis)
all <- data.frame(ShortName = pData$ShortName) 
for (gene in probeids$SYMBOL) { 
  # 1. Get gene expression of one of the genes (using the probeid)
  top.gene <- as.data.frame(exprs(geneSummaries)[rownames(exprs(geneSummaries)) == probeids[probeids$SYMBOL == gene, "PROBEID"], ])
  # change rownames from probeids to gene symbols
  colnames(top.gene) <- gene
  
  # Get residuals for every covariate for which we want to adjust (without Diagnosis)
  cov <- c("Sex", "Age", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
  res <- as.list(12)
  for (name in cov) {
    # generate design matrix with only one covariate
    design <- model.matrix(~ get(name), pData)
    fit <- lmFit(t(top.gene), design)
    res[[paste("res", name, sep = "_")]] <- fit$coefficients[, 2] * design[, 2] #residuals(fit, top.genes) * design[, 2]
  }

  # 3. Get gene expression without Suicide removed
  # gene expression with Suicide AND Diagnosis NOT removed 
  expr <- top.gene - design[, 1] - res$res_Sex - res$res_Age - res$res_pH - res$res_PMI - res$res_RIN - res$res_RIN2 - res$res_Suicide - res$res_Type_of_Death - res$res_C1 - res$res_C2 - res$res_C3 - res$res_C4
  # Add data for all genes together
  all <- merge(all, expr, by.x = "ShortName", by.y = "row.names", all.x = T)
}
# Group on diagnosis
samples <- as.data.frame(pData[, c("ShortName", "Dx")])
rownames(samples) <- pData$ShortName
samples <- samples[order(samples$"Diagnosis"), ]
samples$ShortName <- NULL
colnames(samples) <- c("Diagnosis", "Dx")
# Generate Heatmap
rownames(all) <- all$ShortName
all$ShortName <- NULL
samples$Dx <- as.character(samples$Dx)
samples[samples$Dx == "SCZ", "Dx"] <- "Cases"
samples[samples$Dx == "CTL", "Dx"] <- "Controls"
samples$Dx <- as.vector(samples$Dx)
samples$Diagnosis  <- as.character(samples$Diagnosis)
samples[samples$Diagnosis == "SCZ", "Diagnosis"] <- "Schizophrenia"
samples[samples$Diagnosis == "BPD", "Diagnosis"] <- "Bipolar disorder"
samples[samples$Diagnosis == "MDD", "Diagnosis"] <- "Major depression disorder"
samples[samples$Diagnosis == "CTL", "Diagnosis"] <- "Controls"
# specify colors
ann_colors = list(Diagnosis = c(Schizophrenia = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[5], "Bipolar disorder" = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[4], "Major depression disorder" = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[3], Controls = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[1]), Dx = c(Cases = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[2], Controls = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[1]), color = viridis(200))
ann_colors = list(Dx = c(Cases = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[2], Controls = viridis(5, alpha = 0.7)[1]))
pdf("/storage/scratch/users/karolina.worf/MPIP/04.DEX/figures/heatmap_sertad4_epm2a.pdf", width = 12)
pheatmap(t(all), scale = "row", annotation_col = samples, annotation_colors = ann_colors, show_colnames = F, labels_col = "Samples", cluster_rows = F, fontsize = 14, row.names = "Samples")
dev.off()
```

Adding (Dx*Sex) to the model.

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + (Sex * Dx), pData)
head(design)
# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(geneSummaries, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ:SexM")
top.hits
```


## Transcript level

First, run the linear model with correction for all covariates and generate the result table. 

```{r, echo = F}
# generate design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ Dx + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4 + SV1_trans, pData)

# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(transcriptSummaries, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ", adjust = "BH", number = Inf)
head(top.hits)
```

Save the resulting table into an output file. 

```{r}
colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Transcript ID", "Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
write.table(top.hits, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/01_differentially_expressed_transcripts_for_diagnosis.csv", sep = "\t", row.names = F)
```

Generate a volcano plot for the data:

```{r}
# volcano plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/01_volcano_plot_differentially_expressed_transcripts_for_diagnosis.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
volcanoplot(fit2, coef = "DxSCZ", names = fit2$genes$gene_name, cex = 0.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, las = 1)
lp <- -log10(fit2$p.value[,"DxSCZ"])
ord <- order(lp, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
points(fit2$coef[ord, "DxSCZ"], lp[ord], pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = viridis(1))
x <- fit2$coef[ord,"DxSCZ"]
y <- lp[ord]
text(x, y, fit2$genes$gene_name[ord], cex = 1.2, col = viridis(1))
dev.off()
```

# Differential gene expression analysis - PRS

Now, we use the polygenic risk scores based on the SCZ, BPD, MDD and Cross-disorder GWAS instead of the diagnosis as input.

## Load PRS and integrate in phenotype data

```{r}
# load SCZ2 PRS
prs.scz2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/SCZ2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_scz2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load MDD2 PRS
prs.mdd2 <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/MDD2/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_mdd2_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load BIP-2018 PRS
prs.bip <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/BIP-2018/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_bip_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))

# load Cross-disorder PRS
prs.cross.disorder <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/02.PRS/LDpred/Cross_Disorder/03_validate/03_updateMap_all_chr_maf0.01_hwe_IDs_changed_noDup_cd_filtered_PRS_LDpred-inf.txt", sep = ",", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("IID", "PRS"))
```

Now, we add all the loaded PRS to the phenotype (pData) information:

```{r}
pData$PRS.SCZ <- unlist(prs.scz2[prs.scz2$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.MDD <- unlist(prs.mdd2[prs.mdd2$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.BIP <- unlist(prs.bip[prs.bip$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
pData$PRS.CD <- unlist(prs.cross.disorder[prs.cross.disorder$IID %in% pData$IID, "PRS"])
```

## Gene level

### SCZ PRS

First, we will check if we can find any hidden batch effects.

```{r, echo = F}
# setting up the data for SVA
pheno <- pData
edata <- exprs(geneSummaries)
mod <- model.matrix(~ PRS.SCZ + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
mod0 <- model.matrix(~ 1 + Age + Sex + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, data = pheno)
# estimate the number of latent factors
n.sv <- num.sv(edata, mod, method = "leek")
# Apply the sva function to estimate surrogate variables:
svobj <- sva(edata, mod, mod0, n.sv = n.sv)
```

We found 0 surrogate variables, so we can run the DEA with Dx changed to PRS.SCZ:

```{r}
# generate design matrix for SCZ PRS
design <- model.matrix(~ PRS.SCZ + Sex + Age + pH + PMI + RIN + RIN2 + Suicide + Type_of_Death + C1 + C2 + C3 + C4, pData)

# get top DE genes
fit <- lmFit(geneSummaries, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
top.hits <- topTable(fit2, coef = "PRS.SCZ", adjust = "BH", number = Inf) 
head(top.hits) 
```

Save the resulting table into an output file. 

```{r}
colnames(top.hits) <- c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Location", "Gene Symbol", "logFC", "Average Expression", "t-statistic", "p-value", "FDR estimate", "B coefficient")
write.table(top.hits, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/results/02_differentially_expressed_genes_for_SCZ_PRS.csv", sep = "\t", row.names = F)
```

Generate a volcano plot for the data:

```{r}
# volcano plot
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEX/figures/02_volcano_plot_differentially_expressed_genes_for_SCZ_PRS.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
volcanoplot(fit2, coef = "PRS.SCZ", names = fit2$genes$gene_name, cex = 0.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, las = 1)
lp <- -log10(fit2$p.value[,"PRS.SCZ"])
ord <- order(lp, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
points(fit2$coef[ord, "PRS.SCZ"], lp[ord], pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = viridis(1))
x <- fit2$coef[ord,"PRS.SCZ"]
y <- lp[ord]
text(x, y, fit2$genes$gene_name[ord], cex = 1.2, col = viridis(1))
dev.off()
```

```{r, echo = F}
n.sv <- num.sv(edata, mod, method = "leek")

```

We found 0 surrogate variables, so we can run the DEA with Dx changed to PRS.MDD:

Get significantly differentially expressed genes for all the different covariates. 

```{r, echo = F}
# Get padj values for all different covariates
nc = ncol(design) - 1
limma.res.fc = topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf)
limma.res.padj = limma.res.fc[, 5:(4 + nc)]
#limma.res.padj
for (i in 1:nc){
    limma.res.padj[, i] = topTable(fit2, adjust = "BH", sort.by = "none", number = Inf, coef = i + 1)[, 9]
}
head(limma.res.padj)
colnames(limma.res.padj) <- c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death1", "Type_of_Death2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death <- (limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death1 + limma.res.padj$Type_of_Death2) / 2
limma.res.padj <- limma.res.padj[, c("Diagnosis", "Age", "Sex", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "Suicide", "Type_of_Death", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")]
#pheatmap(as.matrix(limma.res.padj), show_rownames = F)
# check, how many padj values are < 0.10
limma.res.padj.0.05 <- apply(limma.res.padj, 2, function(x) sum(x < 0.1))
limma.res.exon <- as.data.frame(sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T))

# vertical barplot with ggplot2...
pdf("/storage/scratch/users/karolina.worf/MPIP/04.DEX/figures/barplot_significant_DEA_hits_exons.pdf")
ggplot(limma.res.exon, aes(y = limma.res.exon$`sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T)`, x = reorder(row.names(limma.res.exon), `sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T)`))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22)) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = limma.res.exon$`sort(limma.res.padj.0.05, decreasing = T)`), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01))
dev.off()

### BOTH (gene + exon barplot) ###

colnames(limma.res.exon) <- "counts"
```

## Boxplot Suicide vs. No Suicide

Generate boxplot for suicide vs. no suicide in all diagnosis (SCZ, BPD, MDD):

```{r, echo = F, include = F, eval = F, fig.align = 'left', fig.fullwidth = TRUE}
# 1. Get gene expression for the ten genes
# save mapping of probeid to gene symbol
probeids <- geneSummaries@featureData@data[geneSummaries@featureData@data$SYMBOL %in% c("SERTAD4", "HTR1F", "NTN4", "SLC24A2", "BCAT1", "CNGB1", "ESRRG", "CDH6", "SPOCK1", "FBXO9"), c("PROBEID", "SYMBOL")] # using only the 10 hits wihtout suicide as covariate
#probeids <- geneSummaries@featureData@data[geneSummaries@featureData@data$SYMBOL %in% c("SERTAD4", "EPM2A", "DCUN1D2", "GPLD1", "HTR1F", "NTN4", "SLC24A2", "BCAT1", "CNGB1", "ESRRG", "CDH6", "SPOCK1", "FBXO9", "DUSP10"), c("PROBEID", "SYMBOL")] # using all hits

# 2. Get gene expression adjusted for all covariates (except Suicide and Diagnosis)
all <- data.frame(ShortName = character(), Expression = numeric(), Gene = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 
for (gene in probeids$SYMBOL) { 
  # 1. Get gene expression of one of the genes (using the probeid)
  top.gene <- as.data.frame(exprs(geneSummaries)[rownames(exprs(geneSummaries)) == probeids[probeids$SYMBOL == gene, "PROBEID"], ])
  # change rownames from probeids to gene symbols
  colnames(top.gene) <- gene

  # Get residuals for every covariate for which we want to adjust (without Suicide and Diagnosis)
  cov <- c("Sex", "Age", "pH", "PMI", "RIN", "RIN2", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4")
  res <- as.list(10)
  for (name in cov) {
    # generate design matrix with only one covariate
    design <- model.matrix(~ get(name), pData)
    fit <- lmFit(t(top.gene), design)
    res[[paste("res", name, sep = "_")]] <- fit$coefficients[, 2] * design[, 2] #residuals(fit, top.genes) * design[, 2]
  }

  # 3. Get gene expression without Suicide removed
  # gene expression with Suicide AND Diagnosis NOT removed 
  expr <- top.gene - design[, 1] - res$res_Sex - res$res_Age - res$res_pH - res$res_PMI - res$res_RIN - res$res_RIN2 - res$res_C1 - res$res_C2 - res$res_C3 - res$res_C4
  # Save data into a data.frame
  expr <- data.frame(ShortName = rownames(expr), Expression = expr[[1]], Gene = gene)
  # Add data for all genes together
  all <- rbind(all, expr)
}
# Add Suicide and Diagnosis to the dataset
all <- merge(all, pData[, c("ShortName", "Diagnosis", "Suicide")], by = "ShortName", all.x = T)
all$Diagnosis <- factor(all$Diagnosis, levels = c("CTL", "SCZ", "BPD", "MDD"))
# 3. Generate boxplot for each gene showing the suicide effect
#png(paste("/home/karolina/Desktop/PhD/MPIP/workspace/Results/boxplot_", gene, "_suicide2.png", sep = ""), width = 10, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 300) 
p <- ggplot(all, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = Expression)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Suicide)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("No", "Yes"), values = c(viridis(20)[6], viridis(20)[14])) + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), legend.text = element_text(size = 16), legend.title = element_text(size = 18))
p + facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"), strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12))
#dev.off()
```
